entities.summary: Reza Ramezani is a Twelver Shia muslim cleric with the religious rank of Ayatollah. He has been a representative of Gilan in the Assembly of Experts since 2006. From 2009 to August 2018, he was head and director of the Islamic Center Hamburg, the center of Shiite Islam in Germany. Before working in Hamburg, he headed the Islamic Center Imam Ali Vienna. He is also the Secretary-General of the Ahl Al-Bayt World Assembly. Between 2001 and 2005, he represented the Supreme Leader and the Friday Imams in Karaj.
